evidence.decision: Binds metrics to real sensors/activity limitations and separates active-session controls from unrelated navigation and media classes.
evidence.artifact: Delivers lifecycle, sensor availability/provenance and saved/discarded summary contract with corrected workout states.
evidence.transformation: Pool-swim example removes fabricated GPS/frozen live heart rate and separates large Pause/End controls with truthful supported estimates.
evidence.verification: Checks start/pause/resume/end, accidental brief session, sensor absence and wrist return; false live values or saved summaries fail.
evidence.applicability: Limits activity-data session scope to iOS/iPadOS/Watch while distinguishing larger-device fitness media; physical sensors/health recording remain unverified.
evidence.handoffs: Activity rings, HealthKit and Playing audio load only for actual daily progress, data access or session sound needs.
evidence.distinctiveness: Metric provenance by workout type and brief-session disposition distinguish this from generic progress tracking.
